get.description: Returns registry-level capability metadata, including capability schema/spec versions, HTTP API major family, and supported upload profiles such as the v0.1 `http-put` baseline.

VolumeName.description: Canonical full user-facing volume name. Scoped volumes use @scope/name; scopeless volumes use name.

ReleaseUploadIntentRequest.description: The target package name is route-derived. This body supplies the target version and upload constraints; it does not override the path identity.

declaredSize.description: Declared trust attachment byte size. A bibliotheca can reject the upload intent with 413 Payload Too Large when this value exceeds its accepted trust attachment size limit before byte transfer begins.

total.description: Total matching results for the bibliotheca-local query snapshot.

limit.description: Page size used for this catalog search response; not a resolver ordering signal.

offset.description: Zero-based offset used for this catalog search response; search ordering remains bibliotheca-local.

release-upload-intent.schema.title: Agent Volumes Release Upload Intent
release-upload-intent.schema.description: Created for a route-derived target package identity and request-body target version. The target name in this response echoes the reconciled release identity.

mediaType.description: Portable hosted archive upload media type for .tar.gz release bytes.

instructionType.description: Upload profile identifier. The v0.1 portable baseline profile is http-put.

method.description: HTTP method for http-put; omitted or PUT means PUT.

externalDependencies.description: Declaration-only external package dependency metadata derived from the release manifest. These records are not resolved dependency inventory, lockfile content, provenance material, scanner findings, or vulnerability evidence.

url.description: Opaque portable download locator for hosted .tar.gz archive bytes. Clients verify normalized-file-tree integrity after retrieval.

release-upload-finalize.schema.title: Agent Volumes Release Upload Finalize Result

semverRange.$comment: Portable v0.1 dependency range grammar for resolver-facing rows.
Portable v0.1 dependency range grammar for resolver-facing rows.

artifacts.description: May be empty when the release exists but no trust artifacts have been attached yet.

judgments.description: Optional derived judgments; not canonical trust facts.

attachments.description: May be empty when the release exists but no trust artifacts have been attached yet.

format.description: Trust artifact format identity. Baseline examples include CycloneDX JSON BOMs, SLSA provenance predicates, and Sigstore bundle signatures.

family.description: Format family such as cyclonedx, slsa-provenance, or sigstore-bundle.

predicateType.description: Predicate URI for in-toto/SLSA-style artifacts when applicable.

profile.description: Optional profile identifier for a more specific artifact convention.

status.description: Lifecycle status for append-only trust attachments. Superseded attachments are preserved for history but do not satisfy current-state trust evidence.

family.description: Format family such as cyclonedx, slsa-provenance, or sigstore-bundle.

predicateType.description: Predicate URI for in-toto/SLSA-style artifacts when applicable.

profile.description: Optional profile identifier for a more specific artifact convention.

instructionType.description: Upload profile identifier. The v0.1 portable baseline profile is http-put.

method.description: HTTP method for http-put; omitted or PUT means PUT.

format.description: Trust artifact format identity. Baseline examples include CycloneDX JSON BOMs, SLSA provenance predicates, and Sigstore bundle signatures.

trust-upload-finalize.schema.title: Agent Volumes Trust Upload Finalize Result

advisoryVersionEventValue.description: OSV-style introduced events may use 0 as the beginning-of-time sentinel; other values use full SemVer.

component.description: Informational component impact only; does not change the normative volume-level advisory target.

advisoryVersionEventValue.description: OSV-style introduced events may use 0 as the beginning-of-time sentinel; other values use full SemVer.

capability-metadata.schema.title: Agent Volumes Bibliotheca Capability Metadata
capability-metadata.schema.$comment: Unknown peer fields are tolerated for forward compatibility, but portable non-core capability fields are canonically placed under extensions.

compatibleSpecVersions.description: Exact Agent Volumes spec versions the bibliotheca explicitly claims compatibility with. This is a set of exact versions, not a SemVer range expression.

apiVersion.description: HTTP API major family advertised by this capability document.

deliveryModes.description: Known v0.1 baseline values are cdn and git. Unknown values are tolerated and may be surfaced as diagnostics rather than validation failures.

uploadProfiles.description: Supported upload profiles by upload surface. Known v0.1 portable profile value is http-put. Unknown values are tolerated and may be surfaced as diagnostics rather than validation failures.

specVersion.description: Future Agent Volumes specification release where the compatibility bridge is expected to be removed or reconsidered.

invalidArchive.summary: Submitted archive violates the transport profile

digestMismatch.summary: Submitted bytes do not match the declared digest

subjectBindingMismatch.summary: Trust artifact subject does not match the release

missingUploadedBytes.summary: Finalize was requested before upload bytes were available

Unauthorized.description: Authentication needed or invalid bearer token

Forbidden.description: Request is refused by authorization or access policy

Gone.description: Resource no longer available, such as an expired upload intent

PayloadTooLarge.description: Submitted payload or declared upload size is too large
